cards.stem: What does a diploid cell contain according to the definition of inheritance?
cards.quote: Every diploid cell has two alleles, one inherited from each parent.

cards.stem: How is an individual described when carrying different alleles at a locus?
cards.quote: If an individual has two different alleles at a specific locus, the individual is heterozygous at that locus

cards.stem: Which term describes an individual when both alleles at a locus are identical?
cards.quote: if the two alleles are the same, the individual is homozygous.

cards.stem: What general property can the amount of heterozygosity across loci indicate?
cards.quote: The measure of the amount of heterozygosity across loci can be used as a general indicator of the amount of genetic variability.

cards.stem: What share of human genetic diversity comes from individuals of the same population?
cards.quote: The study of genetics has revealed that approximately 85% of human genetic diversity comes from individuals of the same population.
